newsitem.title: USA: Styling Technology to move, CFO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Styling Technology to move, CFO resigns.

text.p: Styling Technology Corp said Thursday its chief financial officer, David Ziegler, had resigned following a company decision to move its executive offices from Dallas to Phoenix.
The company said it will make the move in June but maintain its operating facility here, near Dallas.
Styling said Richard Ross, a former Arthur Andersen LLP manager, will succeed Ziegler.
The company said Ziegler, a long-time resident of Dallas, will be pursuing other interests but will continue to work with Styling on special projects.
Styling produces and markets professional salon products.
